intent: Shows exactly what is about to leave the product for a model or outside tool, with sensitive values masked by type and a mask rule per type, before it is sent. Send, then one line.
useWhen: an agent is about to send customer or company data to a model, API or outside tool
a person should see and control which sensitive values leave masked
secrets must never leave, whatever the person chooses
doNotUseWhen: how much of the model's context is used — ContextWindow
approving one command or edit — ApprovalCard
granting standing access to a resource — PermissionRequest

destination.note: Where the data goes. Title reads "Sending to <destination>".

region.note: Data region of the destination, a Badge ("EU region").

payload.note: Exactly what will be sent, as plain text. Shown read-only in mono.

spans.note: { start, end, type }[] character ranges of sensitive values, e.g. type "email", "card", "apiKey". Overlaps are dropped.

rules.note: { [type]: boolean } mask on or off. Types not listed are masked.

lockedTypes.note: Always masked; their Switch is locked on with lockedReason as the hint.

lockedReason.default: Secrets always stay masked. They are never sent to a model or outside tool.

typeLabels.note: { [type]: label }. Common types (email, phone, card, apiKey…) have defaults.

onRulesChange.note: (rules) => void when a mask Switch flips.

onSend.note: (maskedPayload) => void. Send, the one solid primary. Masked values are replaced by "[type]", or "[Label •••• tail]" with keepLast.

status.note: sent folds to one line ("Sent to … with 10 values masked"); cancelled to "Not sent"; error keeps the card with a danger Alert ("Couldn't send. Nothing left the product.") and Send becomes Try again.

errorText.note: status error: why it failed, the Alert body.

onRetry.note: status error: Try again, the solid primary. Falls back to onSend.

layout.note: split: Before (only you see it; secrets stay masked) and After (exactly what is sent) side by side; on a narrow card After shows first and Before sits behind "Show before".

keepLast.note: { [type]: number } characters kept at the end of a masked value, e.g. { card: 4 } sends "[Card number •••• 4242]". Never applies to lockedTypes.

requirements: masked spans are buttons named "masked <type>"; a Tooltip gives the type and aria-pressed tracks Reveal, which shows the value to the viewer only
unmasked spans carry hidden "unmasked <type>:" text, never colour alone
each mask rule is a labelled Switch; locked Switches are disabled and described by the reason
anything going out unmasked raises a warning Alert
the resolved row is named with what was sent and how many values were masked
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion
status error is a danger Alert (role=alert) and focus moves to Try again
split: Before and After are labelled regions; locked types stay masked in both

doNot: Do not invent a local PiiViewer, MaskedText or DataLeakPanel
Do not bend CodeSnippet to mark spans up
Do not let a person unlock secrets (lockedTypes)
Send is the one solid primary; Cancel is outline
snippet: <RedactionPreview destination="Claude (Anthropic API)" region="EU" payload={ticket} spans={[{ start: 34, end: 52, type: "email" }]} rules={rules} onRulesChange={setRules} onSend={send} onCancel={cancel} />
